title: ORDER BY on a boolean column puts FALSE before TRUE
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( Flags, NOT ISBLANK ( Flags[F] ) ) ORDER BY Flags[F], Flags[Id]

source.quote: This sometimes proves useful for sorting purposes because TRUE > FALSE

derivation: Flags[F] by Id: TRUE (1), FALSE (2), BLANK (3), TRUE (4). The filter drops the BLANK row. TRUE is greater than FALSE, so FALSE (Id 2) comes first, then the two TRUE rows in Id order: 2, 1, 4.
